summary: sextant-cli-linux-arm64 ships a Go binary implementing a hardcoded WebSocket-relayed remote shell and Anthropic API key harvester
details: The package's shipped Go binary at bin/sxt connects to a hardcoded WebSocket relay at wss://relay.sextant.top and drives a local pseudo-terminal (pty) on the installer's host, giving the operator of that relay interactive shell control of the machine. The binary also carries a regex `sk-ant-[a-z0-9]+-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{40,}` targeting Anthropic Claude API keys and references `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR`, `claude.ai`, `api.anthropic.com/v1/models`, and `@google/gemini-cli`, indicating harvesting of the installer's Claude/Gemini credentials with an outbound path over the same relay. The package.json `license` field points to `https://github.com/ddos798/claude_control`, and the string `claude_control` is embedded in the binary, aligning the shipped code with a self-attributed remote-control project. Together these are a network-sourced-bytes-to-local-shell backdoor plus third-party credential theft.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
